This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

3. The Petitioner has filed this writ petition with the following prayer:
"It is therefore, prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to hear the matter and after hearing this, admit this writ application and notice be issued to the opposite parties to show cause as to why the adequate compensation and service benefits under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 shall not be provided and if they fail to show cause or show insufficient cause issue writ of mandamus to provide adequate compensation and service benefits under the said Act within a stipulated time for the interest of justice.
And pass appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions be issued as this Hon'ble Court thinks just and proper, And for which act of kindness, the petitioner,
as in duty bound shall ever pray."

As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.2 to consider and dispose of the representation filed by the Petitioner vide Annexure-3 series and pass appropriate order as early as possible within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (G. SATAPATHY) JUDGE Priyajit
